### Why the listed regions satisfy the four conditions

| Criterion | How the region meets it (2020 UN data) | Notes |

### Which regions *do not* satisfy the criteria

| Region | Failing Criterion(s) | Reason |
|--------|----------------------|--------|
| **Middle East & North Africa** | Rural sanitation < 50 % | Several lower‑income MENA countries (e.g., Yemen, Sudan) have rural sanitation coverage below 50 %. |
| **Sub‑Saharan Africa** (overall) | Internet < 80 %, unemployment > 15 %, rural sanitation < 50 % | Low internet penetration (< 30 %), high unemployment (> 15 %) and poor rural sanitation (< 50 %). |
| **African sub‑regions** (Eastern, Middle, Southern, Western) | None satisfy at least three of the four criteria | Each sub‑region fails at least one key indicator, most commonly unemployed > 15 % or rural sanitation < 50 %. |

2. Europe & Central Asia  
3. East Asia & Pacific  
4. Latin America & Caribbean  
5. Oceania  

All listed regions had the necessary data available in the UNdata 2020 tables. None of the African sub‑regions (Eastern, Middle, Southern, Western Africa) or the overall Sub‑Saharan Africa region met the combined set of thresholds. If no data were available for an indicator in a particular region, that region was treated as failing the check, as per the user’s instruction.
